enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping; phone is on silent on the nightstand.
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Pulls blanket up. Turns to left side. Remains still. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Remains still. Shifts legs. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Turns to back. Remains still. Pulls blanket. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and taking morning chronic-condition medication.
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Turns off tap. Opens medicine cabinet. Takes out medication bottle. Opens cap. Takes out pill. Swallows pill with water. Closes bottle. Puts bottle back. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog around the block on a familiar, well-lit route.
enriched_activities.desc: Leashes dog. Opens front door. Walks out. Closes door. Walks along sidewalk. Holds leash. Crosses street. Turns corner. Continues walking. Returns to house. Opens door. Unleashes dog. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Feeding the dog, brewing tea, and packing breakfast and a lunch for the shift.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens cupboard. Takes out dog food. Pours into bowl. Places bowl on floor. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Opens fridge. Takes out lunch items. Packs lunch bag. Prepares breakfast. Pours tea. Sets items in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast while reading one-on-one text messages from relatives.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Picks up spoon. Eats cereal. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens messaging app. Reads text. Types reply. Sends. Continues eating. Sips tea. Reads another message. Types reply. Finishes eating. Picks up plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work clothes and packing the bag with badge, diary, and medication.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Puts on shirt. Takes out pants. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens bag. Places badge inside. Places diary inside. Takes medication from cabinet. Places in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing the school run and drop-off before the shift begins.
enriched_activities.desc: Steps out of front door. Closes door. Walks down driveway. Turns left. Walks along sidewalk. Passes house number 5. Crosses street at crosswalk. Waits for signal. Continues walking. Passes park. Arrives at school. Opens gate. Walks to main entrance. Speaks to teacher. Nods. Turns around. Walks back. Exits school. Walks to bus stop.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking public transit to the community clinic and reviewing the day's appointment list on the phone.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits. Takes out phone. Unlocks. Opens calendar app. Reviews appointments. Scrolls. Reads notes. Bus stops. Gets off. Walks to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: On-site clinic shift: intake, blood pressure and wellness checks, and recording case notes for community clients.
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at clinic. Turns on computer. Opens scheduling software. Greets first client. Escorts to exam room. Takes blood pressure. Records. Asks questions. Types notes. Escorts out. Calls next client. Repeats. Greets client. Measures blood pressure. Records in chart. Asks about symptoms. Types notes. Escorts out.

enriched_activities.activity: Short lunch break near the clinic, eating lunch and picking up a small cash-budget errand.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to café. Enters. Orders food. Pays cash. Receives food. Sits at table. Eats. Drinks. Wipes mouth. Picks up trash. Throws away. Walks to store. Enters. Buys item. Pays cash. Exits. Walks back to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Primary education aide duties at the school: supporting small reading groups and preparing classroom materials.
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at school. Enters classroom. Greets teacher. Sits at small table. Listens to student read. Helps with pronunciation. Points to words. Turns page. Prepares worksheets. Cuts paper. Stacks papers. Organizes materials. Puts in folder.

enriched_activities.activity: Community outreach visits, checking in on elderly neighbours and delivering appointment reminders.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to neighbour's house. Knocks. Waits. Greets. Enters. Asks about health. Listens. Delivers appointment reminder. Leaves. Walks to next house. Knocks. Greets. Enters. Checks medication. Leaves. Walks to next house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking public transit home and replying to one-on-one text messages from neighbours.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits. Takes out phone. Unlocks. Opens messages. Reads. Types reply. Sends. Reads next. Types reply. Sends. Bus stops. Gets off. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking the bag, preparing dinner, and setting out evening medication.
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Puts bag on counter. Unzips. Takes out lunch container. Puts in sink. Opens fridge. Takes out vegetables. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Opens cabinet. Takes out medication. Places on counter. Closes cabinet. Turns off stove. Serves food.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and listening to the family's day recounted.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Serves food. Picks up fork. Eats. Listens. Nods. Speaks. Picks up cup. Drinks. Continues eating. Finishes. Picks up plate. Stands. Walks to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, wiping counters, and packing leftovers for the next day.
enriched_activities.desc: Opens dishwasher. Loads dishes. Pours soap. Closes dishwasher. Turns on. Wipes counter with cloth. Opens fridge. Takes out containers. Places leftovers in containers. Closes containers. Puts in fridge. Closes fridge. Wipes table. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting quietly with the TV on low, letting anxiety settle after the shift.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Lowers volume. Watches screen. Stares. Shifts position. Puts remote down. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Opens eyes. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Puts remote down. Watches TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending detailed one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbours under the desk lamp.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Takes out phone. Unlocks. Opens messaging app. Selects contact. Types message. Sends. Selects next contact. Types message. Sends. Pauses. Reads reply. Types reply. Sends. Selects next contact. Types message. Sends. Turns off lamp. Puts phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Catching up on remote paperwork and community outreach notes on the computer.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Turns on light. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Waits for boot. Opens word processor. Types notes. Saves file. Opens spreadsheet. Updates cells. Saves file. Closes programs. Turns off computer. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and taking evening medication before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Undresses. Steps in. Washes. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries. Puts on pajamas. Takes medication. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a few pages and writing a short gratitude note to wind down.
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on bed. Picks up book. Opens to page. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Opens drawer. Takes out notebook. Picks up pen. Writes note. Closes notebook. Puts away. Turns off light. Lies down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the light off and the phone charging across the room.
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Remains still. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to other side. Remains still. Pulls blanket. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Turns to back. Remains still.
